sermon.title: What Does God Save People From? 09/03/2017
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer asks what Jesus saves us from: sin, this present evil world, evil people—told through a motel break-in where God’s peace kept him—fear, sickness, the wrath to come and the second death. He examines the fearful, the unbelieving, the abominable and murderers of Revelation 21:8, shows from Scripture that God hates evil, and says Christians who stand for right are not haters.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Points to check: Psalm 11:5 and Proverbs 6:16–19 paraphrased; “sixteen hundred and some” children murdered and “over six hundred thousand” sexually abused yearly; accountability “once you turn 20”. Sensitive content kept as spoken: armed motel robbery and a childhood knife robbery in Detroit (soiling himself); “just like when I shot myself”; Robert E. Lee statues and the gay-wedding cake as “hate” labels; Russia collusion as a distraction; communists, socialists, liberals, the Democratic Party “for the majority” and 15–20% of Republicans dividing America; “nothing wrong with us hating the evildoer”; homosexuality and abortion “wrong”; a divorce over false accusations.

faqs.question: What did he pray during the robbery?
What are the wages of sin?
What is the second death?
faqs.answer: The lake that burns with fire.

faqs.question: Are believers raptured out of the wrath?
faqs.answer: He says no, delivered from it.

faqs.question: What is the state of one who does not believe?
Does God hate?
faqs.answer: Yes, the wicked and the violent.
